This deliberately synthetic page remains useful without a model. Two uses of
"action" have separate identities and source destinations.

::: {#math-group-action .local-ai-source data-source-label="Mathematics: group action"}
## Group action

A group action assigns a transformation to each group element. The identity
acts as the identity transformation, and composition respects multiplication.
This definition concerns algebra, not an educational research method.
:::

::: {#education-action-research .local-ai-source data-source-label="Education: action research"}
## Action research

Action research is an inquiry approach in which practitioners investigate and
reflect on changes to their practice. It does not assert a group action.
:::

::: {#evidence .local-ai-source data-source-label="Evidence and generated proposals"}
## Evidence and review

A generated proposal is unreviewed. A source reference identifies material to
inspect; it does not prove that the material supports every generated claim.
An absence of search results does not establish that a proposition is false.
:::

::: {.local-ai}
Search these sources by a term or source identity. Read the original source for context.
:::
